gaps.sentence: They accused me of ___ the rules.
It took me ages ___ used to the new keyboard.
gaps.explanation: it takes time + to-infinitive: took me ages to get used to the keyboard.
fail takes the to-infinitive: failed to meet.

gaps.sentence: He'd sooner ___ than ask for directions.
gaps.explanation: would sooner + bare infinitive (like would rather): sooner drive.

gaps.sentence: She admitted ___ the last train and had to take a taxi.
gaps.explanation: 'Admit doing' — confess to a past action takes the gerund.
Negative infinitive: promised not to be late — 'not' goes before 'to'.

gaps.sentence: We stopped at a village ___ some lunch.
gaps.explanation: stop to do = pause in order to do something: stopped to have lunch.

gaps.sentence: It was kind of them ___ us a lift to the station.
gaps.explanation: 'It was kind of them to give …' — to-infinitive after the adjective.
